security_spec.violation_condition: XiangShan AtomicsUnit ignores aq/rl bits (inst[26:25]) entirely — the decode table uses wildcard '??' for these bits in LR/SC/AMO BitPat patterns, and the AtomicsUnit FSM never inspects or enforces acquire/release ordering semantics. No memory fence is injected for .aq, .rl, or .aqrl annotated atomics. Under Zaamo/Zabha/Zacas, if the spec mandates differentiated aq/rl behavior, XiangShan treats all AMOs identically, violating the memory consistency model.
security_spec.summary: AMO aq/rl ordering bits are wildcarded in decode and never enforced in the pipeline FSM, causing multi-hart memory ordering violations when Zaamo-spec-compliant software relies on acquire/release semantics for synchronization
